answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 links a channel to better conversion and pipeline quality, but omits realized revenue and retention. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits discount effects on margin, customer quality, and long-term retention. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or early funnel improvements, but do not connect them to qualified revenue or retention. Memory 91 is weakest because it reports only week-one engagement and first-action behavior, with no evidence of durability or downstream revenue quality.
